The company reported healthy revenue growth in Q2FY27, supported by improving demand trends, distribution expansion and market share gains across focus markets.
Management remains confident of surpassing its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 20%, while maintaining its EBITDA margin guidance of 13–14%.
